description: A Java class 'AudioTrackBridge' that wraps and manages Android's AudioTrack for audio playback, including tunnel mode support, buffer management, and timestamp retrieval.

classes.name: AudioTrackBridge
classes.description: A wrapper class for Android's AudioTrack, providing additional control, tunnel mode support, and timestamp management.

methods.name: getBytesPerSample
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per sample based on the audio format.

methods.name: AudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AudioTrack with specified parameters, handling tunnel mode and buffer size.

methods.name: isAudioTrackValid
methods.description: Checks if the internal AudioTrack instance is valid.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume gain for the AudioTrack.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the AudioTrack buffer and resets internal states.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the AudioTrack, supporting both byte array and float array, with optional presentation timestamp.

methods.name: writeWithAvSync
methods.description: Handles writing audio data with synchronization headers in tunnel mode.

methods.name: getAudioTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio timestamp, ensuring monotonic frame position.

methods.name: getUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the underrun count of the AudioTrack.

methods.name: getStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames, API level 31+.
